Incident Bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: svc-text-gen - sustained 5xx spike in us-east (alerts: error-rate > 15% for 3m). Incident page: https://redwood.incidents/INC-2026-1721

Alex V: grabbing this - i'm primary oncall. i'm at my desk but heads-up i have a handoff gap 12:00-12:30 (secondary will be delayed). can someone confirm coverage for 12:10-12:30?

Maria Chen: i'm the listed secondary but stuck on a flight w/ poor service. ETA ~12:40 PT. i can ssh in if needed but limited. if this persists beyond 10m, please page infra-lead.

Jamal K: i'm on-call backup (roamer). i can take over if Alex needs a hard handoff. ping me with @Jamal K or use the /handoff command in the runbook.

Sara D: quick triage - logs show repeated KV timeout to redis-cluster-a. sample errors:
```
[2026-05-10T11:58:12Z] svc-text-gen ERROR request_id=abc123 kv_get timeout=500ms key=user:ctx:987
[2026-05-10T11:58:13Z] svc-text-gen ERROR request_id=abc124 downstream=redis-cluster-a conn_err=EOF
```
I ran a simple curl test to the backend pool and saw 503s from host 10.12.8.21:
```
curl -s -w "%{http_code}" -o /dev/null http://10.12.8.21/health
# returns 503
```

Alex V: doing a quick mitigation - switching traffic to fallback model-legacy pool and dropping KV cache lookups for 1 minute to reduce pressure. command run:
```
# set service routing fallback
redwoodctl route set svc-text-gen --pool=model-legacy --reason "kv timeouts"
# toggle cache bypass
redwoodctl config set svc-text-gen.cache_prefix_bypass true --duration 60s
```
Output: OK -> traffic shifted, new requests show lower 5xx but still elevated.

Incident Bot: update: severity escalated to SEV1 (customer impact - prod requests failing). 5m check scheduled.

Ops Lead: good mitigation. rule reminder for escalation: page primary immediately (that's Alex), if no ack within 5 minutes page secondary, if no mitigation or regression in 10 minutes page infra-pager and eng-platform leads. page message should be "P1 svc-text-gen persistent 5xx - need infra assistance".

Maria Chen: noted. since i can't reach console reliably, i'm authorizing Jamal to take over if Alex wants to step out.

Jamal K: will stand by. if infra needs to be paged: use `pd incident create --service infra --summary "P1 svc-text-gen persistent 5xx" --urgency high` or ping #infra-pager.

Sara D: adding runbook pointers in this thread for whoever takes over:
- Runbook: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/svc-text-gen
- Quick triage steps: check redis-cluster-a metrics, rotate pool, disable cache lookups, increase client timeouts
- Rollback: revert routing via `redwoodctl route set svc-text-gen --pool=primary`

Alex V: status update after routing change: 5xx rate dropped from 18% -> 9% over 3 minutes. still seeing tail errors. continuing monitoring. if we see customer-facing errors again, escalate to infra.

SRE Bot: automation note: auto-retry queue disabled for svc-text-gen (reason: prevent amplification) — action logged by bot.

Ops Lead: decision: continue mitigation and monitor. if error-rate < 10% after next 5m window, we keep fallback for 15m and then attempt gradual switchback. if error-rate >= 10% or latencies increase page infra immediately.

Alex V: ack. i'll keep thread updated and will handoff to Jamal at 12:20 if Maria not online. please follow the escalation steps above. :hand: :rotating_light:

Maria Chen: thanks all — i'm monitoring DM and will update when i land.

Jamal K: standing by.

Incident Bot: next scheduled check 1740000900. logs aggregated to incident page.

Alex V: final note for handoff checklist (copying to thread so it's discoverable):
- Confirm primary/secondary/backup presence
- List active mitigations (routing fallback, cache bypass)
- Share runbook links and PD escalation command
- Record customer impact and timeline on the incident page
- If stepping out, explicitly @mention handoff recipient and timestamp

Maria Chen: added a short comment on the incident page with my flight ETA.

Ops Lead: thanks everyone. good communication. once stable, we'll schedule a quick post-incident sync tomorrow to review paging timings and see if we need stricter auto-escalation rules. :white_check_mark:
